description: This source file defines the CommandResolver enum, providing various static methods for resolving command paths, managing project roots, constructing command line invocations, and handling SSH remote commands related to the 'openclaw' project. It encapsulates logic for verifying executable presence, path management, and remote SSH command generation.

classes.name: CommandResolver
classes.description: A utility enum encapsulating functions for command path resolution, project root management, and SSH-based remote command execution for the openclaw project.

methods.name: gatewayEntrypoint
methods.description: Determines the main JavaScript/Node.js entry point file for the project by checking existing files in prioritized order.

methods.name: runtimeResolution
methods.description: Resolves and retrieves the runtime environment for executing commands, using default search paths.

methods.name: makeRuntimeCommand
methods.description: Constructs a command line array to execute a specific runtime with given entrypoint and additional arguments.

methods.name: runtimeErrorCommand
methods.description: Generates a command array that outputs an error message related to runtime resolution failure.

methods.name: errorCommand
methods.description: Creates a shell command sequence that outputs an error message and exits with a code 1.

methods.name: projectRoot
methods.description: Resolves and returns the project root directory as a URL, checking stored preferences and default fallback locations.

methods.name: setProjectRoot
methods.description: Stores a user-defined project root path into user defaults.

methods.name: projectRootPath
methods.description: Returns the file path string of the current project root.

methods.name: preferredPaths
methods.description: Builds and returns an ordered list of preferred executable search paths, incorporating environment variables and project-specific directories.

methods.name: preferredPaths(home:current:projectRoot:)
methods.description: Generates a list of preferred executable paths based on home directory, current environment PATH, and project root.

methods.name: openclawManagedPaths
methods.description: Finds managed directories related to openclaw within the user's home directory.

methods.name: nodeManagerBinPaths
methods.description: Identifies directories containing node version manager shims/tools like Volta, asdf, fnm, and nvm.

methods.name: versionedNodeBinPaths
methods.description: Lists paths for specific Node.js versions installed in a base directory, sorted by version descending.

methods.name: findExecutable
methods.description: Searches for an executable file with a given name in specified or preferred paths.

methods.name: openclawExecutable
methods.description: Finds the 'openclaw' CLI executable in the search paths.

methods.name: projectOpenClawExecutable
methods.description: Locates the project's local 'openclaw' executable if it exists (only in debug mode).

methods.name: nodeCliPath
methods.description: Gets the path to the Node.js CLI script used by openclaw.

methods.name: hasAnyOpenClawInvoker
methods.description: Checks if any openclaw command-line invoker is available in the environment.

methods.name: openclawNodeCommand
methods.description: Constructs the command array to invoke openclaw via Node.js or remote SSH, choosing among available options and handling different modes.

methods.name: openclawCommand
methods.description: Alias for openclawNodeCommand; constructs the command to run openclaw.

methods.name: sshNodeCommand
methods.description: Builds an SSH command array to invoke openclaw on a remote host, including scripts to run on the remote server.

methods.name: connectionSettings
methods.description: Retrieves remote connection settings from defaults and config, including mode, target, identity, project root, and CLI path.

methods.name: connectionModeIsRemote
methods.description: Checks if current connection mode is remote.

methods.name: sanitizedTarget
methods.description: Cleans up the SSH target string by trimming whitespace and removing 'ssh ' prefix if present.

methods.name: parseSSHTarget
methods.description: Parses an SSH target string into user, host, and port components.

methods.name: sshTargetValidationMessage
methods.description: Provides validation error messages for SSH target strings.

methods.name: shellQuote
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in a shell command.

methods.name: expandPath
methods.description: Expands a file path with ~ to an absolute URL.

methods.name: normalizeSSHTargetInput
methods.description: Normalizes SSH target input string by trimming whitespace and removing 'ssh ' prefix.

methods.name: isValidSSHComponent
methods.description: Validates SSH hostname or username component for allowed characters.

methods.name: makeSSHTarget
methods.description: Constructs an SSHParsedTarget from user, host, and port if valid.

methods.name: sshTargetString
methods.description: Converts an SSHParsedTarget back to its string representation.

methods.name: sshArguments
methods.description: Builds SSH command-line arguments for connecting to a remote host and running a command.
